name: invoist
description: Create, edit and bill invoices in your Invoist account from a conversation.

interface.longDescription: Run your Invoist invoicing from a conversation. Describe billable work and ChatGPT saves a draft invoice with line items, tax and totals calculated by Invoist, or turns your tracked hours into one. Look up, add, edit and delete clients, drafts and expenses, log time, record payments you've received, change your invoice settings, and ask what you've invoiced and what's still outstanding. If you travel for work, log your stays and see how many days you've spent in each country and how they count toward the limits you track, such as Schengen 90/180. Every invoice stays in Invoist for you to review, download as a PDF or send.
defaultPrompt: Invoice my client for my unbilled hours this month.
How much have I invoiced this year, and how much is outstanding?
Which of my invoices are overdue?
